rounds.plan: Turn left and test the adjoining passage.
Face the next direction and check for an open passage.
Try the passage to the right.
Turn away from the mirror and enter the next passage.
Take the remaining untested direction.
Check the side views for a real opening.
Check each direction once for an exit.
Take the untested passage opposite this mirror.
Continue down the open corridor.
Turn right at the mirror blocking the corridor.
Check the corridor ahead beyond the blocked right side.
Turn left at the corridor's mirrored end.
Check the opposite side for an open passage.
Advance into the passage, then turn right to explore its branch.
Leave the two mirrored sides behind and take the opposite passage.
Turn left to inspect the exit around the mirrored end.
Advance toward the mirrored end of this passage.
Turn left and follow the passage around the front mirror.
Turn away from the close mirror and take the opposite passage.
Take the open passage to the left.
Turn left to check for an exit beside the front mirror.
Continue along the corridor toward the distant mirror.
Inspect the left turn at the mirrored corridor end.
The left side is a mirror; inspect the opposite passage.
Return to the corridor heading and advance to the next cell.
Inspect the left exit at the corridor end.
Left is blocked by a mirror; inspect the right exit.
Turn back toward the southern branch and test its exit.
Check the corridor ahead to the left of this mirror.
Continue along the straight passage.
Advance to the next junction along the corridor.
Inspect the right-hand exit at the mirror.
Advance along this passage to the mirror.
Inspect the left passage beside the mirror ahead.
Check the opposite side for a real passage.
Advance toward the more distant mirror straight along the corridor.
Inspect the left exit beside the close mirror.
Turn from the close mirror to inspect the opposite exit.
Advance one cell, then inspect the left branch.
Take the opposite branch away from the close mirror.
Inspect both side exits at the close mirror.
Follow the open corridor ahead.
Advance to the corridor end and inspect the left exit.
The left exit is mirrored; check the opposite passage.
Advance toward the distant mirror, then inspect the next left exit.
Take the opposite passage away from the mirror.
Inspect the left exit beside the front mirror.
Turn away from the close mirror and take the opposite exit.
Backtrack out of the dead end and check the next continuation.
Backtrack along the known corridor and inspect an unexplored branch.
Check the opposite branch; this side is a close mirror.
Both side branches are mirrored; continue back to the next junction.
Explore the untested left passage at this junction.
Return to the junction and explore its untested straight continuation.
Explore the untested passage to the left of this mirror.
Check the remaining exit beside the blocked mirrors.
Inspect the left turn at the close mirror.
Advance to the mirror ahead, then inspect the left exit.
Take the opposite exit away from the close mirror.
Advance toward the distant reflection, then inspect the next side passage.
Follow the open straight corridor.
Advance to the corridor end and inspect the left exit.
Check the opposite exit; the left side is mirrored.
Backtrack two cells and inspect an untested side passage.
Inspect the opposite side of this corridor for an opening.
Backtrack one cell and inspect the next side passage.
Inspect the opposite branch, away from the close mirror.
Return to the junction and explore its remaining branch.
Inspect the opposite exit from this junction.
Advance to the next junction and inspect its left exit.
Inspect the opposite exit, away from the close mirror.
Continue one cell along the corridor and inspect the next left exit.
Check the opposite exit at this mirrored corner.
Advance to the next mirror and inspect the left passage.
Take the opposite passage away from the close mirror.
Inspect both side exits at the mirror.
Follow the corridor toward the distant reflection.
Advance toward the corridor end and inspect the right branch.
Inspect the opposite branch, away from the close mirror.
Advance to the corridor end, then inspect the right-hand exit.
Advance one cell along the right-hand passage, then inspect the left exit.
Check the opposite passage beyond this mirror.
Backtrack from the mirrored dead end and inspect the next branch.
Try the untested side passage beside the close mirror.
Backtrack two cells and inspect a previously skipped side passage.
Inspect the opposite side, then the next corridor junction.
Inspect the opposite side for an open branch.
Advance along the corridor and inspect the next side opening.
Check the opposite side for an open passage.
Enter the open side passage and inspect its left turn.
Check the opposite exit away from the close mirror.
Backtrack from this mirrored dead end and test the corridor's remaining continuation.
Backtrack one cell and inspect its side passages.
Backtrack along the corridor and explore beyond the previously checked branch.
Inspect the left exit beside the blocking mirror.
Check the opposite exit from the mirrored corner.
Advance through the open cell and inspect the next turn.
Check the opposite side for an exit from this mirrored corner.
Follow the open corridor toward the distant mirror.
Check the left exit around the blocking mirror.
Inspect the side passages at the mirror ahead.
Inspect the opposite exit; the wall ahead is a mirror.
Advance toward the farther mirror and inspect the next left exit.
Follow the open corridor ahead.
Advance to the mirror and inspect both side exits.
Backtrack one cell and inspect both side branches for an opening.
Continue back one cell and inspect both side passages.
Backtrack to the next cell and inspect both side exits.
Return to the junction and inspect its remaining exits.
Return along the open passage to the earlier junction.
Inspect both side exits at the close mirror.
Advance to the next corner and inspect its exits.
Follow the open corridor toward the distant mirror.
Inspect both side exits beside the blocking mirror.
Take the open passage opposite this mirror.
Advance to the mirror and inspect the side exits.
Advance one cell toward the farther mirror and inspect the side exits.
Enter the open passage and inspect the turn at its end.
Check the opposite side for an exit away from the mirror.
Backtrack from the mirrored dead end and test the junction's remaining continuation.
Test the untried continuation beyond this junction.
Return along the known corridor to search earlier junctions.
Advance to the next corner and inspect both exits.
Take the open passage opposite the close mirror.
Inspect both side exits at the mirror.
Take the open passage opposite the close mirror.
Inspect both side passages at the blocking mirror.
Take the long passage opposite this direction.
Advance to the mirror and inspect both side passages.
Backtrack one cell and inspect both side branches.
Continue back one cell and inspect both side exits.
Both sides are mirrors; backtrack one cell and check the next junction.
Continue back to the next junction and inspect both side exits.
Follow the open right-hand passage and inspect the next junction.
Advance to the next mirror and inspect both side exits.
Advance through the open passage and inspect the next corner.
Take the open passage opposite this mirror and advance three cells.
Advance to the mirror and inspect both side exits.
Enter the open right passage and inspect the next turn.
Check the opposite side for an opening around the mirrors.
Leave the dead end and test the junction’s remaining continuation.
Backtrack along the corridor and check the next cell’s side exits.
Continue back along the open corridor and inspect the next side exits.
Continue back along the corridor and check the next pair of side exits.
Both side walls are mirrors; continue to the next cell and inspect its exits.
Enter the open passage and inspect both exits at its end.
Take the passage opposite the close mirror, then inspect the next corner.
Turn around and follow the open corridor two cells.
Inspect both side exits beside the close mirror.
Take the longer passage opposite this view.
Advance to the corridor end and inspect both side exits.
Backtrack one cell and inspect both side passages.
Continue back one cell and inspect both side exits.
Continue back through the corridor and inspect the next side exits.
Return to the next junction and inspect its side exits.
Follow the open passage two cells, then inspect both side exits.
Advance to the mirror and inspect both side exits.
Advance to the next cell and inspect both side exits.
Take the open corridor opposite this mirror.
Inspect the exits beside the front mirror.
Advance through the opening and inspect both side exits.
Backtrack from the mirrored dead end and test the junction’s remaining branch.
Backtrack two cells and inspect a side passage.
Check the opposite side for a real opening.
Return to the corridor, advance one cell, and inspect both side exits.
Continue along the corridor and inspect the next side exits.
Advance through the opening and inspect the next side passages.
Take the open passage opposite the close mirror and inspect the next junction.
Take the open corridor opposite the close mirror.
Inspect both side exits at the blocking mirror.
Advance to the next mirror and check the right-hand exit.
Follow the open corridor ahead.
Advance to the mirror and inspect both side exits.
Follow the open passage toward the distant mirror.
Inspect both exits beside the close front mirror.
Backtrack from the mirrored end and inspect the junction’s untested continuation.
Check the opposite branch at this junction.
Inspect both side exits before the mirror ahead.
Continue down the open corridor, then inspect both exits.
Take the open corridor opposite the close mirror.
Approach the distant mirror and inspect the side passages.
Backtrack one cell and inspect both side branches.
Continue back one cell and inspect both side passages.
Continue along the corridor and inspect both sides at the next cell.
Continue along the corridor and inspect the next junction.
Follow the open passage toward its far end.
Inspect the side exits at the mirror.
Follow the open corridor ahead.
Take the left exit around the blocking mirror.
Inspect both side exits at the close mirror.
Advance to the farther mirror and inspect the next exits.
Follow the open passage ahead.
Inspect both side exits at the close mirror.
Take the passage opposite the close mirror and inspect its next junction.
Take the open corridor opposite the close mirror.
Inspect both side exits at the blocking mirror.
Advance through the opening and inspect the next turn.
Follow the open corridor to its next turn.
Advance to the next mirror and explore the turn beyond it.
Explore the remaining passages, continuing around mirrored barriers toward the beacon.
